Players Committee card image of [[Dannik Jerriko (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Opponent's characters just lost from here may not be removed from Lost Pile (except to be placed out of play). While present at a site and armed with a blaster, adds one battle destiny. Cards hit by Dannik are power and forfeit -2.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/dannik_jerriko.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/dannik_jerriko.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
